result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make **compassion a condition of power**. Anyone who governs, owns, or controls resources would have to show that their decisions preserve people’s dignity and ability to thrive—not merely obey the minimum rules.

Much cruelty survives not because most people are evil, but because systems reward the callous. I’d change what the world rewards.
